snippet.title: Ultrapool | Release Date Announcement | Secret Sauce Showcase trailer
snippet.description:
Icedrop Games and offbrand games have released a new trailer for Ultrapool, the wild pool roguelike all about landing crazy trickshots with even crazier balls. It's coming out on PC, iOS, and Android on August 25th!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4195110/Ultrapool/

Secret Sauce Showcase Steam Event: http://obp.gg/secretsauce2026
